title: Explicit low-dimensional input for the relative critical-graph theorem

sources.title: Polynomials with constant Hessian determinants in dimension three
sources.author: Michiel de Bondt
sources.role: Theorem 2.1, only its n=2 assertion: a complex polynomial in two variables with nonzero constant Hessian determinant has an invertible polynomial gradient. The primary paper attributes the two-variable result to Dillen. No four-variable theorem or full normal-form classification is imported.

other_inputs: Tang and the compactly supported curve formula, curve-product argument and endpoint source-orbit equivalences are retained from prior proofs.
